name: claude-usage-lens
description: Fine-grained Claude plan usage in the VS Code status bar: live tokens plus decimal estimates of your 5-hour, weekly and per-model limits.

commands.title: Claude Usage Lens: Show full report

claudeUsageLens.pollSeconds.description: How often to read the official usage numbers. Shorter gives sharper calibration but risks rate limiting.

claudeUsageLens.statusBarBuckets.description: Limit buckets to show in the status bar, by endpoint key (e.g. five_hour, seven_day, seven_day_fable). Empty = 5-hour, weekly, and any Fable bucket. The full report lists available keys.

claudeUsageLens.officialRounding.description: How the official whole-number percentage is rounded. 'floor': 37 means 37.0–37.99. 'round': 37 means 36.5–37.49.

claudeUsageLens.claudeDir.description: Claude Code config folder. Empty = CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude.

claudeUsageLens.priceOverrides.description: Override per-model weights (USD per million tokens), keyed by a substring of the model id. Example: {"fable-5-1": {"input": 10, "output": 50, "cacheWrite5m": 12.5, "cacheWrite1h": 20, "cacheRead": 0.25}}

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
